title: ElTab: Elastically Looped Tabular Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.41819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular transformer models such as TabPFN achieve strong predictive performance but incur substantial inference costs, making them difficult to deploy in resource-constrained settings. While looped transformers reduce parameter count through weight sharing, they can lose significant predictive power when stopped early. To address this challenge, we introduce the Elastically Looped Tabular Transformer (ElTab), a single model trained to operate across different computational budgets through supervision at randomly sampled early exits. Across 30 OpenML classification datasets, a single ElTab model matches six depth-specific looped models while cutting training cost by more than half, and matches a 12-layer TabPFN-style baseline with 25% fewer inference FLOPs. These results show that elastic-depth training yields a single model that adapts to the deployment budget at hand, offering a favorable trade-off among predictive performance, storage,

translated_abstract: 诸如 TabPFN 之类的表格 Transformer 模型能够取得强大的预测性能，但推理成本高昂，使其难以部署在资源受限的环境中。虽然循环 Transformer 通过权重共享减少了参数数量，但在提前停止时可能会损失大量预测能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了弹性循环表格 Transformer（ElTab），这是一个通过在随机采样的提前退出点进行监督而训练出的单一模型，能够在不同的计算预算下运行。在 30 个 OpenML 分类数据集上，单个 ElTab 模型可与六个针对特定深度的循环模型相媲美，同时将训练成本削减了一半以上；并且与 12 层 TabPFN 风格的基线相比，以减少 25% 的推理 FLOPs 达到了同等性能。这些结果表明，弹性深度训练能够产出一个可适应当前部署预算的单一模型，在预测性能、存储和推理成本之间提供了有利的权衡。
tldr: ElTab 是一种弹性深度的循环表格 Transformer，通过在随机提前退出点进行监督训练，使单一模型能够适应不同的计算预算，在大幅降低训练成本和推理 FLOPs 的同时达到与多个专用模型相当的性能。
en_tdlr: ElTab is an elastically deep looped tabular transformer trained with supervision at randomly sampled early exits, enabling a single model to adapt to varying computational budgets while matching multiple specialized models with over half the training cost cut and 25% fewer inference FLOPs.
